Done. Verified end-to-end: `curl /admin` returns **`HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`** and renders the styled error page, while `/` returns 200.

What I created/changed:

- **`app/admin/page.tsx`** — a Server Component that calls the existing `verifyAdmin()` helper and invokes `forbidden()` (Next.js's built-in auth boundary function from `next/navigation`) when the session role isn't `admin`. `forbidden()` throws, which sets the 403 status and renders the nearest `forbidden.tsx` instead of continuing.
- **`app/forbidden.tsx`** — the nice 403 error page (centered "403 Forbidden" with an explanation and a "Return home" link), rendered inside the root layout.
- **`next.config.ts`** — enabled `experimental.authInterrupts: true`, which Next.js requires to use `forbidden()`/`unauthorized()`.

Files: `app/admin/page.tsx:5` (`forbidden()` call) and `app/forbidden.tsx:9` (error UI).
